paragraphs: Mobile-first workout tracker for personal gym and surf preparation. Version 40.

Version 40 adds the non-destructive World Trip Surf Performance program: twelve editable monthly plans with four 72–75 minute sessions on Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday and Saturday, surf-specific power and shoulder-prehab work, progressive running, conservative starting loads, exercise rest targets, monthly benchmarks and an automatic every-fourth-week deload. Existing plans and workout history remain available. The complete rationale and prescription are documented in docs/surf-year-plan.md.

Training separates the weekly gym plan and optional stretching into two sections. On rest days stretching comes first and the gym plan starts collapsed; on gym days stretching follows the gym plan. Stretching management supports creating, editing, copying and deleting routines, editing individual guided stretches, and assigning routines to rest weekdays. Routine settings synchronize with the account; saved calendar entries retain their original exercises and instructions.
